summary: Implemented exact global order/choice allocation with active-hold capacity accounting, terminal eligibility rules, duplicate canonicalization, and deterministic ASCII tie-breaking.
tests_run: Validated shared-stock global optimum, active/expired/terminal holds, group and tie objectives, duplicate IDs, conflicts, and immutability
limitations: Exact exhaustive search is intended for the specified bound of at most 18 distinct orders and 3 choices each.
